subject: test(material/sort): switch tests away from fakeAsync (#33716)
reviewer: Codex primary implementer; independent audit remains separate

hunk_reviews.judgment: Review all eight hunks of the complete sort spec migration. Pair all26 static cases;23 callback semantics are unchanged and three fakeAsync callbacks become native async, replacing three tick calls with fixture.whenStable for initialization and disabled-column arrow observations. All26 predicate expressions and all other operations remain equal. Two default-option setup callbacks lose waitForAsync, retaining their provider objects; all five setup hooks and11 fixture classes/templates are accounted for without declaring initialization/injector/render equivalence. Decline the private fixture migration. Public MatSort remains directly used by the owned legacy table data source, which merges sortChange with initialized, and its retained table-data-source specs import MatSortModule. Cyph renders actual matSort/mat-sort-header directives on legacy table markup. Preserve these public contracts, the historical M2 sort Sass and all existing comparator/initialization/data-source tests; no MatSort fork, modern API mirror, assertion weakening or CSS/SCSS change. Actual packed/public-peer initialization, sort rendering/data updates and both supported floors remain unexecuted.
